free_tier.stated: Free, no account, no payment. 'Downloading files requires passing through 3 short advertisement pages.' No byte or link allowance is published anywhere on the site.
free_tier.notes: The 'unlimited' unit records the site's own claim, not a measured absence of a cap. No limits, terms or FAQ page resolved: /terms and /faq both returned 404.

per_object_cap.stated: none published. The public recent-downloads table showed a 63.6 GB torrent and a 19.16 GB 1fichier file completed on the read date.

retention.stated: not applicable: links only. The site says generated premium links are removed after the download finishes.

egress.terms: The service fetches the file to its own server and hands back a direct link; no byte cap is stated. 'Sec... resume supported ... no waiting time'.

interface_detail: Web form taking links, magnets or a .torrent; returns a /download/<hash> URL that any HTTP client can pull.
tooling: Any HTTP client on the returned link; no plugin and no API documented.
chaining: The only zero-cost service whose own statistics show multi-gigabyte files completing, so it is the first thing to try before paying.

limits.value: no concurrency number published; the ad gate is three pages per download

limits_note: The failed-unlock rate is the real ceiling: 287 of 369 attempts in the last 7 days were errors. A failed attempt costs the ad pages and the wait, which the site reports as up to 20 minutes on a slow host.

identity_cost.detail: No account, no email and no card on the free path. The site says 'No account, no payment, no software install'.

reliability_note: Self-reported success rate was 21.1% over the last 7 days and 8.0% for the month (78 successes against 887 errors); advertisement pages are mandatory per download; generated links are deleted after download.
confidence_note: The free model and the statistics are quoted from the vendor's own pages, including its own failure counts. The statistics are self-reported, so the success rate is at the reported rung even though the page is the vendor's.

evidence.proved: 'Last 7 Days 369 links generated ... Success 78 Errors 287 Success Rate 21.1% Size 1.08 TB'; 'This Month 969 ... Success 78 Errors 887 Success Rate 8.0%'; 'All Time 23,483 ... 9,205 successes 13,289 errors 39.2%'

'Please Note: Downloading files requires passing through 3 short advertisement pages', the recent-downloads table with 10.33 GB, 19.16 GB and 63.6 GB entries, and completion times from 1 s to 21 minutes

price_per_tb_month: USD 0 on the free tier; no paid tier found on the site
notes: Reached both as mixdebrid.com and through leech.web.id/debrid, which redirects here. The size column in the statistics table reads 1.08 TB for both the 7-day and the month row, which cannot both be right, so only the success/error counts are used. No pricing page was found: the site appears to be funded by the ad gate alone.
